stories.title: Arabia Saudí cierra el oleoducto Este-Oeste, vía que usaba como alternativa a Ormuz

en.title: Saudi Arabia closes East-West pipeline, alternative route to Hormuz
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has shut down the East-West pipeline, which served as an alternative supply route to global markets amid tensions in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Arabia Saudí cierra el único oleoducto que no atraviesa Ormuz tras una oleada de ataques de Irak

en.title: Saudi Arabia closes only pipeline bypassing Hormuz after wave of attacks from Iraq
en.summary: Saudi authorities confirmed attacks on the East-West pipeline traversing the Arabian peninsula to Bahrain and Qatar without crossing the Iranian-controlled Strait of Hormuz, resulting in casualties and forcing the pipeline's shutdown.

stories.title: Arabia Saudí cierra el oleoducto alternativo a Ormuz tras la ofensiva de los hutíes en el mar Rojo

en.title: Saudi Arabia closes alternative pipeline to Hormuz after Houthi offensive in Red Sea
en.summary: Attacks on the alternative pipeline to Hormuz caused injuries, prompting emergency teams to secure the pipeline and assess its safety.

stories.title: La escalada en el mar Rojo obliga a Arabia Saudí a cerrar su único oleoducto alternativo a Ormuz

en.title: Red Sea escalation forces Saudi Arabia to close only alternative pipeline to Hormuz
en.summary: The Red Sea crisis has forced Saudi Arabia to shut its sole alternative pipeline to Hormuz as Houthis expand their control in Yemen, intensifying threats to oil markets.

stories.title: El jefe de gabinete dimite y señala al delegado del Gobierno de Ceuta: «Se alertó a los ministerios»

en.title: Chief of staff resigns and points to Ceuta Government delegate: "Ministries were alerted"
en.summary: The chief of staff to Ceuta's government delegate has resigned over the government's response to a migration crisis in late July. He reportedly received intelligence warnings about the threat before the incident occurred.

stories.title: La sombra de la guerra de Irán planea sobre la conmemoración de Trump del 11-S en el Pentágono

en.title: Shadow of Iran war looms over Trump's 9/11 commemoration at the Pentagon
en.summary: The US president defends military action during a 9/11 memorial event at the Pentagon, reiterating that Iran will not obtain nuclear weapons.

stories.title: Vivas asegura que Moncloa le pidió “que no llamara más” tras días advirtiendo sobre la crisis migratoria

en.title: Vivas assures that Moncloa asked him "not to call anymore" after days warning about migration crisis
en.summary: Ceuta's president claims the central government minimized his warnings about migration pressure at the border with Morocco.

stories.title: Diplomacia Real para destensar las relaciones con Trump: Felipe VI homenajea en Rota a las víctimas del 11-S y reivindica los lazos militares y la base naval

en.title: Royal diplomacy to ease tensions with Trump: Felipe VI honors 9/11 victims in Rota and reaffirms military ties and naval base
en.summary: The Cádiz municipality opens a museum about its links with the United States following American threats to withdraw military presence.

stories.title: Trump aprovecha el acto de recuerdo a las víctimas del 11-S para justificar su guerra en Irán

en.title: Trump uses 9/11 remembrance event to justify his war in Iran
en.summary: The president skips the main New York ceremony to deliver a speech from the Pentagon instead.

stories.title: Dimite el jefe de gabinete del delegado del Gobierno en Ceuta acusándolo de mentir: sí tuvo conocimiento del aviso del CNI

en.title: Chief of staff of Ceuta government delegate resigns, accusing him of lying: he did receive CNI warning
en.summary: Gonzalo Sanz claims reports from various agencies demonstrate that warnings were issued from the government delegation to different ministries.

stories.title: Dimite el jefe de gabinete del delegado de Ceuta tras asegurar que sí informó del aviso del CNI

en.title: Chief of staff of Ceuta delegate resigns after confirming he reported CNI warning
en.summary: The delegate claims that Gonzalo Sanz did not share information from a CNI agent about social media calls for irregular immigrant entry into the city.

stories.title: Dimite el jefe de gabinete del delegado del Gobierno en Ceuta insistiendo en que elevó el aviso del CNI

en.title: Chief of staff of Ceuta government delegate resigns insisting he conveyed CNI warning
en.summary: Gonzalo Sanz contradicts the delegate's account, who maintains he was unaware of the WhatsApp message or call from the intelligence agent warning about irregular border crossing calls on social media.

stories.title: Bancos: cómo subirse al tirón en Bolsa

en.title: Banks: how to ride the stock market wave
en.summary: Rising interest rates improve sector expectations despite valuations at record levels. Experts recommend selective investment after six consecutive years of gains in the stock market.

stories.title: Cómo armar la cartera de inversión tras la subida de tipos

en.title: How to build your investment portfolio after interest rate increases
en.summary: The European Central Bank raised rates to 2.50% and the Federal Reserve may increase its rates next week. Investors should adapt their portfolios to the new interest rate environment.

en.title: Where is oil heading?
en.summary: Escalating Middle East conflict with attacks on energy infrastructure increases supply disruption concerns, pushing oil prices higher despite weakening demand from elevated prices.

stories.title: VW, Toyota y Stellantis llevan a récord los ingresos del automóvil

en.title: VW, Toyota and Stellantis drive automotive revenue to record levels
en.summary: Inflation and sales of higher-equipped models boost major automakers' revenue to over 1.04 trillion, though profitability remains at minimum levels.

stories.title: Apple lleva el iPhone a una escala inédita de precios: hasta 3.839 euros

en.title: Apple takes iPhone to unprecedented price scale: up to 3,839 euros
en.summary: Apple has increased prices across its mobile phone lineup by up to 26%, presenting a significant challenge for new CEO John Ternus following the foldable Duo launch.
